patches.name: Bypass PairIP
patches.description: Disables adidas Running's PairIP licence/VM verification, restores the real Application class and bakes the VM's runtime strings (captured from the original app's heap) so Firebase etc. initialize cleanly. NOTE: adidas runs the full PairIP VM whose startup program is the tamper check — the patched app boots past the licence gate but the VM-virtualized init methods cannot be restored without native reverse engineering, so the app may crash after launch. See docs/adidas.md.

patches.name: Extra settings resources
patches.description: Registers the Extra Settings activity and applies the accent color.

options.description: Replaces the Strava orange brand color family app-wide.
Exports Strava's hidden SuperUserToolsActivity for adb access (feature-switch console, modular-UI tools, network settings). DEBUG-ONLY: any on-device app could then launch it. Off by default.
Removes the subscriber lock from the sticker/share overlay carousel (all client-rendered designs become selectable).

patches.name: Extra settings screen
patches.description: Adds an 'Extra Settings' entry at the top of Settings with theme mode switching and patch info. Accent color is a build-time option.

patches.name: Remove telemetry
patches.description: Strips Sentry, Embrace and Facebook analytics, disables Firebase analytics, and empties the advertising ID (push notifications keep working).

patches.name: Remove upsells & promos
patches.description: Removes Strava's subscription upsells and promos: server-driven modular upsells (matched by an upsell-shape predicate so new server types stay covered), subscription bottom-sheet upsells, and the dedicated upsell screens (Year in Sport 2026, Best Efforts Data Peek, Device Connect). Runtime toggles in Extra Settings; the Settings Subscriptions section is stripped.

patches.name: Unlock Premium
patches.description: Unlocks Strava Premium features (spoofs PAID state + far-future expiry). Also re-enables password login after OTP.

patches.name: Disable AppsFlyer
patches.description: No-ops AppsFlyer's start() and logEvent() entry points, so no install attribution or analytics events are sent.

patches.name: Disable trackers
patches.description: Disables AppsFlyer/Facebook/Google measurement components, switches Facebook app events and Firebase/Crashlytics/Google-Analytics collection off, and removes the install-referrer permission. Push notifications are kept.

patches.name: Remove ads
patches.description: Stops Google Mobile Ads from initialising (removes the AdMob app id) and strips the advertising-ID, ad-services and install-referrer permissions. Ad slots in the Flutter UI cannot be removed, but they no longer fill.

patches.name: Disable AppsFlyer
patches.description: Neutralizes AppsFlyer attribution/telemetry: the SDK is never initialized or started, and the JS bridge reports success as usual.

patches.name: Disable CleverTap
patches.description: Stops CleverTap session/activity tracking and push-click attribution. Push notifications themselves keep working.

patches.name: Disable Firebase Performance + installer check
patches.description: Makes Firebase Performance's connection wrapper a pass-through (no perf telemetry) and reports installs as Play-installed regardless of the actual installer.

patches.name: Disable SSL pinning
patches.description: Removes certificate pinning at both layers (OkHttp pin comparison and the platform network-security-config pin-set) and trusts user-installed CAs, so HTTPS traffic can be inspected with a MITM proxy. Normal TLS validation stays intact.

patches.name: Disable security checks
patches.description: Stops MyDialog from exiting itself on root/debug/emulator/adb detection and on Play Integrity failure. Signature verification is reported clean so patched builds pass.

patches.name: Disable trackers
patches.description: Disables Google Analytics measurement and Facebook SDK auto-init, and turns off Firebase Analytics/AdID data collection via their official opt-out flags.

patches.name: Fix SIM identifier access
patches.description: Replaces the IMSI lookup with the public getSimOperator() call so the pre-login flow passes on Android 11+ where re-signed builds lost carrier privileges ('App Error: NO IMSI'). Falls back to Dialog's 41305 on SIM-less devices.

patches.name: Inspect HTTPS traffic (adb reverse proxy)
patches.description: Routes RN network traffic through 127.0.0.1:8080 on the device (adb reverse tunnel to mitmproxy). Off by default; needs the tunnel and a trusted CA.

patches.name: Kill residual beacon traffic
patches.description: Silences the Facebook SDK's remaining phone-home: app-event uploads (/activities, /app) and the SDK config fetch (mobile_sdk_gk). The SDK class init stays alive (required by RN); only transmission dies.

patches.name: Remove AI assistant FAB (+ footer patch id)
patches.description: Removes the server-driven AI overlay FAB from every screen and surfaces the Morphe patch version on the side-menu footer ("ID ⚡<version>" next to the device id).

patches.name: Spoof stock signing cert hash
patches.description: Makes NativeUtils.setAppToken() return the stock app's certificate hash instead of the patched build's, so the server-side device/app integrity verdict ('App Error: NO IMSI') is not tripped by the re-signed APK.

patches.name: Unlock hidden feature flags
patches.description: Flips the server-sent feature flags showO2A/showO2AShop/showO2ABuy/showUber/showDeleteAccount to true in every API response before the JS sees it, revealing app screens the server hides.

patches.name: Allow standalone install (split-less APK)
patches.description: Removes Pdb's base-APK split requirement (requiredSplitTypes=base__abi,base__density) so the single patched APK installs. Required when patching the App Bundle's base APK.

patches.name: Bypass PairIP license check
patches.description: Disables Pdb's PairIP / Play licence verification so the app runs after Morphe re-signs it. Restores the real Application class (pdb.app.App).

patches.name: Chat button on profiles
patches.description: Adds a 'Chat' entry to the profile screen's ⋯ menu: opens your conversation with that user when one exists, otherwise their profile (channels are server-created — no fake channel making).

patches.name: Disable trackers
patches.description: Disables Google Analytics measurement and Yandex AppMetrica telemetry, and turns off Crashlytics/Analytics data collection via their official opt-out flags.

patches.name: Fix app icon
patches.description: Gives the default launcher icon a real foreground. The base APK ships an adaptive icon with a null foreground (the visible icon normally comes from a theme alias enabled at runtime).

patches.name: Floating power button
patches.description: Adds a draggable quick-actions bubble to the main screen (profile IDs / receipts / pause toggles, copy your profile id, open Pdb Extras). Toggle: Pdb Extras → Quick → 'Show floating power button'.

patches.name: Mock Pro (client-side)
patches.description: Forces the app's client-side pro flag (isProUser → true) and the local ProStatus model: premium-badge UI, client-gated perks (unlimited rewinds, hide online, extra IRL slots) and pro-only screens open. Honestly: features the SERVER re-validates (premium Soul filters, coins, boosts, some AI limits) still refuse — that is a backend check no client patch can lift.

patches.name: No profile-visitor limit
patches.description: Lifts Pdb's client-side cap of 3 profile-visitor views per hour (the 'slow down' sheet). Toggle: Pdb Extras → Limits → 'No profile-visitor limit'. The bytecode ships always-on and is inert until the switch is on.

patches.name: Pdb Extras feature menu
patches.description: Adds a single Pdb Extras entry to the top of Pdb's Settings screen.

patches.name: Pdb Extras — resources
patches.description: Adds the Pdb Extras entry to the Settings screen and registers the extension components.

patches.name: Relocate runtime MMKV copy
patches.description: Copies the bundled MMKV library to a fresh file name so a stale copy from another ABI can never be loaded (fixes emulator crashes; no effect on a clean device).

patches.name: Remove ads
patches.description: Disables Pdb's ad SDKs (GMS, AppLovin, Vungle, Yandex, Pangle) and turns off in-app ad initialisation.

patches.name: Show profile IDs on names
patches.description: Appends the numeric profile id (#1234567) after every profile name — Soul cards, chat headers, lists. Toggle: Pdb Extras → 'Show profile IDs on names'. The bytecode ships always-on and is inert until the switch is enabled, so the toggle works without rebuilding.

patches.name: Soul history
patches.description: Records every Soul profile you see or like into a local, on-device history (Pdb Extras / power button → 'Soul history'), so swipes survive the server's short feed window.
